title: Heliocentric Astrology (1910 Edition)
author: Holmes W. Merton
description: The 1910 edition of Holmes W. Merton's work on heliocentric astrology. It introduces a Sun-centred approach to astrological interpretation and records the concepts associated with that historical system.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. Source text obtained from the Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/heliocentricast00mert).
rights: From the curator's private collection. Publication rights for this edition are to be confirmed before public release.
